name: Six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system
specs: Compatible with master and slave pallets
summary: Perfectly solves heavy product palletizing challenges. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with accuracy controlled within ±0.5mm and speed up to 12 seconds per piece.
contentHtml:
The six-axis robot intelligent palletizing system is a core device developed by TXAM for post-production line logistics automation.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a six-axis industrial robot (optional ABB, Yaskawa, etc.) combined with an intelligent control system to achieve automatic product palletizing. Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets, with strong compatibility.

Technical Advantages

  • Palletizing accuracy of ±0.5mm, neat and stable stacking
  • Efficiency up to 12 seconds per piece
  • Supports simulator palletizing and master/slave pallets
  • Compatible with products of different sizes and shapes

Model Description

TX-NS-PR series (01/02/03) and integrated palletizing TX-NS-RIP-001, the latter with more powerful functions including master/slave pallet stacking, automatic pad placement, scanning, etc.
